description.value: Timberlane Beach Resort sits directly on sandy Saratoga Beach on Vancouver Island, offering six oceanview suites and four cabins tucked among old-growth Douglas firs, plus an RV park. Guests walk a tree-lined laneway to reach the Pacific shoreline, and the resort is open year-round. The property offers bike rentals and can arrange local activities including trail riding, fishing, and golf.
